screen.title: Settings
screen.noAdvancedHere: No advanced settings on this page

details.beginner: Full TC & ABS, racing line, steering assist
details.sim: No TC, no ABS, no racing line

autoOvertake.label: Automatic Overtake
autoOvertake.hint: 2026 F1: uses an earned Overtake on the straights, with less power than pressing {key}

autoClutch.label: Auto clutch
autoClutch.hint: Prevents stalling; disable for manual clutch launches

overridden.gearbox: Temporarily overridden (requires manual gearbox); turn on to restore default
overridden.wheel: Temporarily overridden (bind clutch under controls > wheel); turn on to restore default
overridden.controller: Temporarily overridden (bind clutch under controls > controller); turn on to restore default
overridden.touch: Temporarily overridden (unavailable with touch controls); turn on to restore default
overridden.keyboard: Temporarily overridden (bind clutch under controls > keyboard); turn on to restore default

gamepadAssist.label: Controller steering assist
gamepadAssist.hint: Limits lock to front tyre grip and catches slides

exitAssist.label: Throttle help
exitAssist.hint: Modulates throttle on rear slip (keyboard, TC off)

brakeAssist.label: Brake help
brakeAssist.hint: Modulates brake on lock-up (keyboard, ABS off)

pedalAssistStrength.label: Pedal help strength
pedalAssistStrength.hint: How early and how far Throttle help and Brake help ease the keys back

triggerRumble.label: Trigger rumble
triggerRumble.hint: Slip, ABS and wheelspin feedback in triggers

wheelBrakeGamma.label: Brake curve
wheelBrakeGamma.hint: 1.0 for load cell · 1.3 to 1.6 for potentiometers

touchLayout.label: Touch style
touchLayout.hint: Analogue drag sliders or digital buttons

ffbCurve.label: Force curve
ffbCurve.hint: Negative lifts low forces · positive reserves peak headroom

details.low: No shadows or bloom, lower res

sharpLow.label: Sharp Low
sharpLow.hintAuto: Draws Low at Medium resolution; auto quality can turn it off

sharpen.label: Sharpen
sharpen.hint: Crisps edges and tarmac after scaling

autoQuality.label: Automatic quality
autoQuality.hint: Steps down on sustained frame drops

autoQualityMinScale.label: Lowest resolution
autoQualityMinScale.hint: Automatic quality never drops Render resolution below this
autoQualityMinScale.hintLow: Resolution stays put; Low has no effects to drop
autoQualityMinScale.hintEffects: Resolution stays put; only effects step down

telemetryOut.label: UDP telemetry
telemetryOut.hint: Sends live telemetry to local bridge (dashboards, bass shakers)

hints.off: No damage in practice or a time trial
hints.reduced: Half the damage; a wrecked car restarts a flying lap, repaired
hints.full: Race damage; a wrecked car restarts a flying lap, repaired

placement.title: Size and position
placement.resetWhat: the HUD size and this layout's panel positions
placement.editHint: Move and resize this layout's panels on the live HUD.

camera.title: Camera
camera.freeCameraHint: Drag look · WASD fly · Q/E height · Scroll speed · R reset
camera.resetSeatsBody: Resets cockpit and dash seat offsets for all cars.

stats.title: Your stats
stats.note: Every session added up. Only you see these.

data.identityKeyHint: Signs online laps. Back up to use on another browser
data.resetAllHint: Restores default controls, assists, display and audio
data.resetAllBody: Resets all settings, bindings and calibration to defaults. Profile, setups and lap times stay.
data.clearHint: Deletes local settings, driver key, laps, ghosts and setups
data.clearBody: Permanently removes all settings, driver key, laps, ghosts and setups from this browser, then reloads. A signed-in device is signed out of its account first; the account and its cloud save stay.

hudPicker.label: HUD layout
hudPicker.thirdPartyNote: Recreated from other open-source HUD projects, credited to their authors.
hudPicker.sourceLink: {layout} source, by {author} (opens in a new tab)

account.unavailable: Accounts are not available right now. Try again later.
account.deletedLaps: The account and its laps are deleted.

page.intro: Accounts are optional. An account keeps your driver names and save on every device, and no email is collected. Sign in here to see what your account holds, or to delete it.
page.privacy: What an account stores is on the <link>privacy page</link>.

signedOut.title: Account
signedOut.description: Sign in to keep your driver names and save on every device. No email is collected.
signedOut.codeLabel: Use a code from another device
signedOut.codeHint: On a device that is signed in, choose Show a code, then type it here
signedOut.oauthHint: Opens their sign-in page, then comes back here
signedOut.passkeyHint: A passkey on this device, a phone or a security key
signedOut.createLabel: Create an account with a passkey
signedOut.needsBrowserCode: {providers} sign-in needs a browser. Sign in at librecorsa.org/account, choose Show a code, and type it here.

signedIn.combineHint: This device and the account both have a save
signedIn.signOutHint: This device keeps its save. It posts laps under your names again once you sign in
signedIn.lastWay: The last way in can’t be removed. Delete the account instead.

names.title: Driver names
names.description: Every device on this account can post laps under these names. They stay yours while the account exists.
names.none: No driver names yet. The name you post your first lap under joins the account.
names.elsewhere: {count, plural, one {{names} is on another account.} other {{names} are on another account.}} To combine the two, add that account’s sign-in below.

ways.title: Ways to sign in
ways.description: Only the account’s id at each is kept: no email, user name or picture.
ways.addPasskeyHint: Signs in with this device’s screen lock, a phone or a security key
ways.combinePasskey: Combine with an account that has a passkey
ways.combinePasskeyHint: Its names, devices and save join this account
ways.desktopOthers: Other sign-ins can be added at librecorsa.org/account in a browser.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: The browsers and apps signed in to this account.
devices.notJoined: A device that hasn’t joined yet

keys.title: Driver keys
keys.description: Each device signs its laps with its own driver key. Every key here may post under the account’s names.
keys.none: No driver keys yet. A device adds its key when it joins the account.

remove.identityBody: {provider} no longer signs in to this account. You can add it again later.
remove.passkeyBody: It no longer signs in to this account. You can also delete it from the device or password manager that keeps it.
remove.keyBody: Laps from {label} no longer post under the account’s names. Its laps already on the boards stay.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.label: Delete this account
delete.hint: Deletes its sign-ins and cloud save. You choose whether your laps stay
delete.question: Delete this account?
delete.body: This deletes the account, its sign-ins and its cloud save. What is saved on this device stays.
delete.lapsGo: Your driver names come off the boards with their laps, race results and badges, and are free for anyone to take.
delete.lapsStay: Your driver names and laps stay on the boards. Without an account, a name lapses after six months without a lap.
delete.tick: Also remove my laps and race results from the boards

join.joining: Joining… This device’s save is syncing with the account. It can take a moment.
join.body: This device’s driver names and save become part of that account. Not now signs this device out.
join.codeBody: This device’s driver names and save become part of that account.

firstSync.title: Combine the two saves?
firstSync.intro: This device and the account both have a save.
firstSync.bestLaps: {count, plural, one {<n>#</n> best lap} other {<n>#</n> best laps}}
firstSync.setups: {count, plural, one {<n>#</n> saved setup} other {<n>#</n> saved setups}}
firstSync.combineExplain: Combine. Keeps both. Where both changed the same thing, the newer change wins.
firstSync.cloudExplain: Use the cloud save. This device takes the account’s settings, setups and race history. Its own are replaced.
firstSync.localExplain: Keep this device’s save. The account takes this device’s settings, setups and race history. Other devices get them at their next start.
firstSync.bestLapsKept: Best laps from both are always kept.

code.title: Use a code from another device
code.how: On a device that is signed in, open Settings, then Profile and data, then Account, and choose Show a code.
code.label: Code
code.format: A code is 8 letters and numbers, like ABCD-EFGH

showCode.label: Show a code for another device
showCode.hint: Signs another device in to this account, such as the desktop app
showCode.left: {minutes, plural, =0 {Less than a minute left. It works once.} one {# minute left. It works once.} other {# minutes left. It works once.}}
showCode.expired: This code has run out. Choose New code for another.
showCode.how: On the other device, open Settings, then Profile and data, then Account. Choose Use a code from another device and type this code.
